posts.t:
The QM and DM are brilliant for new traders, as they have simple rules on clear PA.

But as you advance, you'll begin to understand more and more the
propaganda and psychological manipulation. Then you'll be able to see
the retailers being tricked into trading in the right direction for
subsequent stophunts.

Veteran RTMers love the stophunt, as it provides high yields fast
posts.fa:
QM و DM برای معامله‌گرهای تازه‌کار درخشان‌اند، چون قوانین ساده‌ای روی PA واضح دارند.

اما هرچه پیشرفته‌تر شوی، کم‌کم پروپاگاندا و دستکاری روانی را بیشتر و بیشتر درک می‌کنی. آن‌وقت می‌توانی ببینی که معامله‌گرهای خرد فریب می‌خورند تا در جهت درست برای شکار حد ضرر‌های بعدی معامله کنند.

اهل باتجربهٔ RTM شکار حد ضرر را دوست دارند، چون بازدهٔ بالایی را سریع می‌دهد

any sort of IT pa at that particular timeframe that we should be aware
of that a stophunt is eminent ? Thank you for your time if you will

The ITs profit from every scale.

As they're bringing price in one direction on an high scale, they'll be trading against that direction in the lower scales.

As I see it, their mandate is to have price at a certain level by a
certain date, while taking as many stops as they can on the way
